newsitem.title: UK: Alliance & Leicester may drop flotation plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Alliance & Leicester may drop flotation plan - paper.

text.p: The planned stock market flotation of British building society Alliance and Leicester could be abandoned after a board meeting on Thursday, the Times said.

Alliance and Leicester said it had received legal advice that its transfer document, which has been mailed to 3.5 million savers and borrowers, contains information that would be misleading if a planned new Building Societies Bill was published, the paper reported.
The planned flotation, estimated to be worth 2.5 billion stg ($4.2 billion), is due to be voted on by members of the society at a special meeting on December 10.

New legislation being drafted has abandoned a clause which gives converting societies five years protection from hostile takeover bids. When the Alliance and Leicester drew up its transfer document, it was based on present legislation.
